title: Stonier Winemaker Dinner at Ember
summary: Ember at The Continental Sorrento gives over one night to Stonier, with a multi-course menu matched to the estate's wines. Thursday 24 September, booking required.
priceRange: Ticketed; price on the venue listing
nearbyAttractions: Sorrento front beach; Sorrento back beach; the Queenscliff ferry
suggestedItineraryPairing: Dinner at Ember on the Thursday, then stay in Sorrento for the Grand Final weekend
editorVerdict: Stonier is one of the founding pinot and chardonnay names on the Peninsula, and this is a single sitting. If you want it, book it.
editorNote:
Ember gives over a single Thursday to Stonier, one of the founding pinot and chardonnay names on the Peninsula. It runs as a seated multi-course dinner with each course matched to a Stonier wine, hosted alongside the winery.

One sitting only, so the table goes when the night is booked out. Confirm the current price, the booking link and any dietary requirements direct with the venue.

It sits well for anyone already heading down the coast for the Grand Final weekend.
